# `security-alternative-added`

New alternative in the security OR list

| | |
|---|---|
| **Kind** | `wire` |
| **Default severity** | `info` |
| **Rule IDs** | `security-alternative-added` |
| **Status** | Implemented (M3) |
| **Group** | Security ([RULES.md section 3](../../RULES.md)) |

## What it detects

A new alternative was added to the `security` list (OR).

## Why this default

Clients can keep using the alternative they already use.

## Example

From test case [`security-alternative-added`](../../test/cases/security-alternative-added/): A new alternative in the OR list.

`openapi.yaml`, base → revision:

```diff
  …
        security:
        - apiKey: []
+       - oauth:
+         - read
        responses:
          '200':
```

Findings:

- `security-alternative-added` · info · GET /pets

## Policy options

Every rule takes `severity` (`error`, `warn`, `info` or `off`), `fix` and `explanation` in the policy file. The policy file arrives in M6; see [POLICY.md](../../POLICY.md).

```yaml
rules:
  security-alternative-added: info
```
